summary: PhD chemist/materials scientist with 6+ years in polymer/materials characterization, DOE-guided process development, and structure-property analysis. Currently develops bio-based polymer process windows and uses FT-IR, GPC/SEC, DSC/TGA, NMR, UV-Vis, and structured data to translate formulation/process variables into reproducible specifications.

bullets: Lead DOE-guided bio-based polymer process development, linking formulation and process variables to FT-IR, thermal, GPC/SEC-adjacent, and material-quality readouts for scale-up-ready specifications.
Develop SOP-style records and technical reports that connect polymer characterization data with reproducible process decisions.
Developed and characterized functional organic material variants with FT-IR, UV-Vis-NIR, NMR/GPC, TGA/DSC, electrochemistry, and MS to connect structure, purity, stability, and performance.
Analyzed process-structure-property relationships across 15+ materials and translated complex datasets into design recommendations and peer-reviewed outputs.
Co-led AFOSR-funded thin-film coating process development, connecting CVD/surface-preparation conditions to morphology, interface quality, optical performance, and reproducibility.
Developed CVD polymer thin-film deposition workflows using DOE and in-situ QCM-D monitoring to quantify growth kinetics and process controls.
Managed characterization/process-development lab operations for a 15-member group; implemented calibration, SOP, and safety systems that improved instrument uptime by 30%.
